verdict.rationale: Gitea's core git hosting provides commit history, branching, and PR-based review (docs-1, docs-3), and Gitea Actions lets users define automation workflows as versioned YAML files that live in the repo and can be reviewed via PRs and rolled back via git revert/checkout (docs-2). This directly covers versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations, though evidence is vendor-docs based rather than hands-on confirmation of rollback specifically for Actions workflows.
